name: QuickNet
summary: Springwood/Logan dialup ISP (quicknet.com.au); hosted Dick Johnson Racing's website. NOTE: claimed Dick Johnson/CostPlus ownership not verified — likely conflation of the DJR hosting relationship and Cost Plus Computers' Springwood presence (QUICKNET INTERNET PROVIDER PTY LTD, ACN 078 144 304).

events.details: ISP business wound down (~2007-08). Last branded homepage Dec 2004, domain forbidden by Feb 2012 and later just an SBS server default - 'by Feb 2012' is the hard upper bound.

refs.label: Last branded ISP homepage, 12 Dec 2004 (title-only splash).
May 2013 serves a Windows SBS 2003 default page - domain reduced to a server stub.
